title: Startup Copy Configuration
statement: For every Boolean word $x$ and every natural number $i$ with $i\le |x|$, after $i$ steps the countdown emitter started on $x$ is in its copy phase, with its input head at position $i+1$, its work tape containing the first $i$ bits of $x$, its work head at position $i$, and empty output.
replaced: For every input $x$ and every $i \le |x|$, the $i$-step run of the countdown emitter from its blank-tape initial configuration is the copy configuration holding the first $i$ bits of $x$ with input head at position $i+1$.
